anchors.description: Width of one flat white board cell of the panel wall, measured horizontally between the centres of two adjacent vertical galvanized steel tubes that clamp the board edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: A single flat light-grey board fills the cell between the two tubes; the tubes (with sleeve fittings) run the full cell height and the board edge is flush behind them, so the tube-centre spacing equals the board module width plus one tube radius on each side.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Board is an unlabelled sheet material (plywood/MDF/plasterboard-like) with no visible marking; size inferred from the common 1220 mm sheet module. Board could be 1200 or 1250 mm, which keeps the estimate inside the quoted interval.

anchors.description: Height of one white board cell in the upper row, measured vertically on the board surface between the centres of the top horizontal tube/rail and the middle horizontal tube.
anchors.visible_evidence: The same board that fills the a1 cell continues unbroken from the top horizontal tube down to the middle horizontal tube, where a row joint crosses in front of it; the vertical span is about 1.8x the horizontal module, consistent with a long-side-vertical sheet.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumes the sheet is the wide-format 2440 mm module rather than a shorter 2000 mm board; camera pitch slightly compresses vertical spans, and the measured aspect ratio sits between both sheet formats, so the interval covers the plausible range.
